_experiment_choices.experiment: Value-step ablation pilot (docs/ct_ph_sac_layout.md, Value-step ablation; evaluations/ph_sac/protocol.step_ablation_arms): implicit_explicit_step (one explicit Euler step of length tau = resolvent_step 1 s in place of the resolvent step), implicit_explicit_step_interval (the same with each row's Delta) and implicit_critic_head (explicit_generator's twin critic in place of the rate head for its fit and the actor; resolvent step and learned reward unchanged) and implicit_critic (the critic also read by the resolvent step as (Q - V)/Delta_ref, Delta_ref the clock's mean interval 14.736 ms, no learned reward; an explicit step of about 14.5 ms in the generator); every arm takes torque decisions, as the paper arms (the motor box, -1 entropy per torque); run with --arms implicit_explicit_step implicit_explicit_step_interval implicit_critic implicit_critic_head, and add implicit_torque explicit_generator_torque for the two reference arms on the same settings
_experiment_choices.testbed_settings.torque_limit: 2 N (common/ph_dmc/lqr.py torque_limit, the optional setting of the lqr_6_2 diagnostic of 2026-11-11; the table row keeps 20 N): stiffness 0-20 N/m and damping 0-4 N s/m by the box rule (the feedback box the config holds; the arms' torque box is the +-2 N motor box). The final runs' lqr settings are not in this tree (Vista); check this against them
_experiment_choices.testbed_settings.clock: the irregular rows' clock (benchmarks/make_ct_ph_sac_table.IRREGULAR_CLOCK: two_tail_uniform, tail_probability 0.99, tail_split 0.9) on [T/5, 3T] = [6, 90] ms, mean 14.736 ms = 0.4912 T; the table has no lqr row of mode irregular
_experiment_choices.everything else: the lqr-lqr_2_1 row of mode top (benchmarks/hyperparams/ct_ph_sac.csv): K 400, tau 1 s, N 4, rate/actor steps 200/40, drift-only plant, rk4 at 10 ms, learned reward, always-admit, plant step dense to 100k then every 4th row, evaluation every 20000 decisions on reset seeds 20000-20031, seeds 0-9
